# Winning **Together**

At Fibertex Nonwovens, we pioneer and innovate the way industries work with nonwovens and
performance materials. We enable our customers to create high-performance and sustainable solutions,
that improve the quality of life for people.

## Business Areas

### Acoustics

Unique sound absorption. We offer you freedomto design with optimal acoustic solutions.

[Read more][252]

### Automotive

We enable our customers to develop and improve automotive parts – excelling in superior lightweight,
high-performing nonwovens solutions.

[Read more][253]

### Bedding

We work closely with our customers in the bedding industry to develop and improve products, using
high-performance nonwovens materials.

[Read more][254]

### BUILDING INDUSTRY

We work closely with our customers in the construction sector, to create dependable construction
solutions, using high-performance materials.

[Read more][255]

### CIVIL ENGiNEERING

The Fibertex geosynthetics range, which is engineered to deliver exceptional performance, provides
the optimal solution for every geotechnical problem.

[Read more][256]

### COMPOSITES

Fibertex’ solutions for composites are used to build some of the longest blades for wind turbines,
luxury boats, the fastest cars, trains, planes, and much more.

[Read more][257]

globally consistency with manufacturing standards and quality controls

as leading specialists in the global nonwovens industry

of certified durability

### Concrete

We have extensive experience in providing dependable solutions for strengthening the long-term
performance of concrete structures in aggressive environments.

[Read more][258]

### FILTRATION

The Fibertex team has been developing high-performance materials and filter media for over 50 years,
to develop advanced filtration products. 

[Read more][259]

### FLOORING

Fibertex has been creating excellent flooring solutions, to meet exact customer requirements, since
our establishment in 1968.

[Read more][260]

### FOOTWEAR

Fibertex has established a leading position in the global footwear market, with a commitment to fine
design and the highest quality manufacturing standards

[Read more][261]

### FURNITURE

Fibertex offers versatile solutions for backings, barriers and reinforcement materials needed to
build exceptional furniture.

[Read more][262]

### Home and garden

Long lasting solutions with minimal maintenance enable you to relax instead of working hard in your
garden.

[Read more][263]

### MEDICO

Fibertex offers a wide range of fabrics, developed especially for use in wound-care and dressings.

[Read more][264]

### WIPES

If your needs go beyond standardised wipes, allow us to work with you to develop products for your
specific requirements.

[Read more][265]

### Special Solutions

Fibertex is committed to developing innovative solutions to meet constantly changing trends.

[Read more][266]

### Looking for something else?

If you haven’t been able to find a product for your exact requirements, please contact us.

Fibertex is committed to developing innovative solutions to meet constantly changing global trends.
So, if there is a nonwovens or fine fibre solution our engineering team could develop specifically
for you, please allow us to do this. 

[Read more][267]

# Winning **Together**

At Fibertex Nonwovens, we pioneer and innovate the way industries work with nonwovens and
performance materials. We enable our customers to create high-performance and sustainable solutions,
that improve the quality of life for people.

## Business Areas

### Acoustics

Unique sound absorption. We offer you freedomto design with optimal acoustic solutions.

[Read more][252]

### Automotive

We enable our customers to develop and improve automotive parts – excelling in superior lightweight,
high-performing nonwovens solutions.

[Read more][253]

### Bedding

We work closely with our customers in the bedding industry to develop and improve products, using
high-performance nonwovens materials.

[Read more][254]

### BUILDING INDUSTRY

We work closely with our customers in the construction sector, to create dependable construction
solutions, using high-performance materials.

[Read more][255]

### CIVIL ENGiNEERING

The Fibertex geosynthetics range, which is engineered to deliver exceptional performance, provides
the optimal solution for every geotechnical problem.

[Read more][256]

### COMPOSITES

Fibertex’ solutions for composites are used to build some of the longest blades for wind turbines,
luxury boats, the fastest cars, trains, planes, and much more.

[Read more][257]

globally consistency with manufacturing standards and quality controls

as leading specialists in the global nonwovens industry

of certified durability

### Concrete

We have extensive experience in providing dependable solutions for strengthening the long-term
performance of concrete structures in aggressive environments.

[Read more][258]

### FILTRATION

The Fibertex team has been developing high-performance materials and filter media for over 50 years,
to develop advanced filtration products. 

[Read more][259]

### FLOORING

Fibertex has been creating excellent flooring solutions, to meet exact customer requirements, since
our establishment in 1968.

[Read more][260]

### FOOTWEAR

Fibertex has established a leading position in the global footwear market, with a commitment to fine
design and the highest quality manufacturing standards

[Read more][261]

### FURNITURE

Fibertex offers versatile solutions for backings, barriers and reinforcement materials needed to
build exceptional furniture.

[Read more][262]

### Home and garden

Long lasting solutions with minimal maintenance enable you to relax instead of working hard in your
garden.

[Read more][263]

### MEDICO

Fibertex offers a wide range of fabrics, developed especially for use in wound-care and dressings.

[Read more][264]

### WIPES

If your needs go beyond standardised wipes, allow us to work with you to develop products for your
specific requirements.

[Read more][265]

### Special Solutions

Fibertex is committed to developing innovative solutions to meet constantly changing trends.

[Read more][266]

### Looking for something else?

If you haven’t been able to find a product for your exact requirements, please contact us.

Fibertex is committed to developing innovative solutions to meet constantly changing global trends.
So, if there is a nonwovens or fine fibre solution our engineering team could develop specifically
for you, please allow us to do this. 

[Read more][267]

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

Geo-Synthetics Systems LLC (GSI) is committed to safety in collaboration with quality, service and
customer satisfaction. The GSI Safety Policy is achieved through continuous awareness and commitment
to safety, starting with the orientation of any new GSI employee and ending only when they return
safely from work every day. GSI, therefore, endorses and requires a concept of safety based on the
principle that it is the basic responsibility of each department and employee of the company.

When it comes to environmental containment, GSI does it all. We are a distributor, fabricator, and
installer of geosynthetic materials for a broad range of environmental containment applications,
including erosion control and contamination clean-up. For over 40 years, we have been a trusted
provider to customers in the power, solid waste, mining, and agriculture industries, gaining a
reputation as the best geosynthetic installer in the trade.

[Learn More][78]

GSI’s construction products focus on finding lasting environmental containment solutions for our
customers. Our slitting, seaming and re-rolling capabilities enable us to tailor products to fit
exact needs and specifications, while our large, centrally located facility allows guaranteed quick
shipments to any destination. In addition to our well-trained, Midwest-based customer service
professionals, we have product specialists located throughout the United States. Whatever your needs
or wherever your site is located, GSI is positioned to serve you.

GSI is one of the largest installers of geotextile liners in the USA. Our installation services have
been utilized by a wide range of industries, including landfills, power and energy, civil
construction, EPA and Corp. of Engineers projects, pulp and paper, oil and gas, aquaculture,
agriculture and mining. GSI’s estimating, project management and construction operations are all
based in Waukesha, Wisconsin. Our installation crews operate from locations across the country,
enabling us to provide competitive local service from coast to coast.

Geo-Synthetics Systems LLC (GSI) is committed to safety in collaboration with quality, service and
customer satisfaction. The GSI Safety Policy is achieved through continuous awareness and commitment
to safety, starting with the orientation of any new GSI employee and ending only when they return
safely from work every day. GSI, therefore, endorses and requires a concept of safety based on the
principle that it is the basic responsibility of each department and employee of the company.

## Why Choose GSI?

When it comes to environmental containment, GSI does it all. We are a distributor, fabricator, and
installer of geosynthetic materials for a broad range of environmental containment applications,
including erosion control and contamination clean-up. For over 40 years, we have been a trusted
provider to customers in the power, solid waste, mining, and agriculture industries, gaining a
reputation as the best geosynthetic installer in the trade.

[Learn More][78]

## [Construction Materials & Fabrics][79]

GSI’s construction products focus on finding lasting environmental containment solutions for our
customers. Our slitting, seaming and re-rolling capabilities enable us to tailor products to fit
exact needs and specifications, while our large, centrally located facility allows guaranteed quick
shipments to any destination. In addition to our well-trained, Midwest-based customer service
professionals, we have product specialists located throughout the United States. Whatever your needs
or wherever your site is located, GSI is positioned to serve you.

[Learn More][80]
[[Construction Materials & Fabrics]][81]
[[Liner & Installation Services]][82]

## [Liner & Installation Services][83]

GSI is one of the largest installers of geotextile liners in the USA. Our installation services have
been utilized by a wide range of industries, including landfills, power and energy, civil
construction, EPA and Corp. of Engineers projects, pulp and paper, oil and gas, aquaculture,
agriculture and mining. GSI’s estimating, project management and construction operations are all
based in Waukesha, Wisconsin. Our installation crews operate from locations across the country,
enabling us to provide competitive local service from coast to coast.

[Learn More][84]

## [Geotextile Tubes][85]

GSI manufactures GEOSTRUX™ Geotextile Tubes for use in a wide variety of projects where dewatering
of sediments and industrial wastes is required. These applications include coal ash ponds,
industrial sludge and sediments, mining tailings, wastewater treatment plant sludge, organic and
inorganic materials, and silts and sands. We also support environmental construction efforts such as
Superfund sites where the EPA manages environmental contamination cleanup projects, as well as
dredging contractors who require efficient dewatering.

[Learn More][86]
[[Geotextile Tubes]][87]

## A Leader in the Industry

GSI is one of the country’s largest independent installers of geotextile liners for landfill sites
and manages installation projects in all parts of the country. Additionally, with its GEOSTRUX™
Geotextile Tubes, GSI has supported sediment cleanup projects on waterways throughout the United
States. GSI is an authorized distributor for many of the most recognized names of geosynthetic
materials and erosion control products. GSI provides effective and responsive product distribution
to landscape, environmental engineering and general contractors from its distribution facility in
Waukesha, Wisconsin.

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

# Downley engineering and market intelligence consultancy

[ [Downley Consultants logo] ][50]

Downley Consultants is a business and engineering consultancy focused on two dynamic and growing
fields of civil engineering:
* Geosynthetics
* Underground pipe network assessment and rehabilitation

In both sectors we provide our clients with professional expert advice on market and competitive
knowledge and intelligence, and engineering design, condition assessment and solutions to problems…

[Marketing information]

Our team of highly experienced leading industry experts provides high quality and high value advice
to inform clients on markets and to solve their technical and engineering problems in our fields of
expertise. Downley Consultants celebrated its 30th anniversary in 2022 and has supported and guided
hundreds of clients around the world successfully, cost-effectively and confidentially. We are proud
of our record of consistently very high client satisfaction throughout that period, reflected in the
high level of repeat business from satisfied clients.

Downley Consultants provides its clients with high-level strategic marketing and market intelligence
so that they can make key management decisions with confidence based on robust and reliable
knowledge of the markets and competitive landscape. We do so based on our extensive engineering
expertise and knowledge in these sectors; in geosynthetics conceptual and preliminary design,
solutions development and specification to achieve sustainable and economic structures; and in
underground utility networks inspection, condition assessment and rehabilitation to extend the
service life of valuable assets that cannot easily be replaced.

Over almost 30 years we have advised and supported our clients across many key activities:
* Global, regional & local market knowledge & research
* Competitive analysis of markets and key segments
* Strategic market analysis and evaluation of options
* Positioning for optimum competitive advantage
* Review and development of winning value propositions
*  Analysis & development of sustainable and economic engineering solutions with geosynthetics
* Inspection, engineering condition assessment and rehabilitation of underground utility networks
* Professional engineering design across all applications in both geosynthetics and underground
  network rehabilitation
* Asset management plans
* Performance- and prescriptive-based technical specifications

applications. They include materials such as **geomembranes, geotextiles, geogrids, geonets,
geocells,** and **geosynthetic clay liners (GCLs)**. These products offer multiple advantages that
enhance the performance, sustainability, and cost-efficiency of modern infrastructure projects.

EcoGeo Material is a premier manufacturer of **geosynthetic materials** located in **Dezhou,
Shandong, China**, with a focus on **quality, innovation, and environmental responsibility**. For
over 10 years, we have supplied **geomembranes**, **geotextiles**, **geocomposites**, and **GCLs**

engineering, aquaculture, sewage treatment, tailwater seepage prevention, landfills, gardening and
landscaping, slope greening, mine restoration and other fields.

#### CLICK ON THE ICON TO EXPLORE THE SECTORS WE WORK IN

✕
[Roads-thumbnail]

### Road

Geofabrics geosynthetics are used in roads to ensure the best construction performance to both
minimise construction costs and prevent costly maintenance disruptions.

Geofabrics provide solutions that encompass all road types, from temporary access tracks to high
volume roads.

[More »][149]
✕
[Waste-containment-thumbnail]

### Waste Management

Geosynthetic engineering is the use of synthetic materials in waste and containment projects to
achieve more cost effective, safer and more environmentally sound outcomes.

The design techniques bring numerous benefits to waste and containment projects, because
geosynthetics can better protect the environment, through the control of hazardous leachates and
liquors.

[More »][150]
✕
[Mining-thumbnail]

### Mining & Resources

Geosynthetic engineering is the use of synthetic materials in civil engineering and mining projects
to achieve more cost effective, environmentally sound and safer construction outcomes.

The design techniques bring particular benefits to mine sites, because geosynthetics maximise the
use of site soils and avoid the need to import additional construction materials. 

[More »][151]
✕
[Slopes-walls-thumbnail]

### Slopes & Walls

Geofabrics offers a range of engineered slope, embankment and retaining wall solutions used to
construct infrastructure projects.

[More »][152]
✕
[Rail-thumbnail]

### Rail

The Geofabrics Rail Division has critical design expertise and a long project history in
the utilisation of geosynthetics for the construction and maintenance of rail formations.

We offer a range of solutions for new track construction as well as renewal or maintenance of
existing railway tracks which can deliver both construction savings and life-cycle optimisation.

[More »][153]
✕
[Water-thumbnail]

### Water

Geosynthetic engineering is the use of synthetic materials in water storage and treatment projects
to achieve more cost effective, environmentally sound and safer construction outcomes.

[More »][154]
✕
[Coastal-thumbnail]

### Coastal

Coastal erosion is a significant problem in Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific with rising sea
levels, extreme storms and climate change having a significant impact on shorelines.

Geofabrics coastal solutions are designed to reduce the effects of coastal and estuarine erosion
whilst maintaining safety and amenity for the community.

[More »][155]
✕
[Tunnel-thumbnail]

### Tunnels

Tunnel construction, maintenance and longevity depends on optimal drainage, waterproofing, sealing,
portals, erosion control and load support.

Geofabrics can provide engineering solutions and testing to reduce costs, while maintaining design
life.

[More »][156]
✕
[Defence-thumbnail]

### Defence

Geosynthetic engineering on defence projects is the use of synthetic materials to achieve more
cost-effective, environmentally sound and safer construction outcomes.

[More »][157]
✕
[Renewable-energy-thumbnail]

### Renewable Energy

We develop geosynthetic solutions for renewable energy infrastructure to reduce cost, environmental
impact and risk, and add value to each project.

[More »][158]
✕
[Port-aviation-thumbnail]

### Ports & Aviation

Geofabrics has a range of geosynthetic solutions for both landside and seaside components of port
infrastructure, including reinforcing hardstand areas, consolidation of soft soils and marine
breakwaters.

[More »][159]
✕
[Sport thumbnail]

### Sport & Recreation

Our aim is to provide product solutions that maximise playing hours on natural and synthetic sport
fields, racetracks and golf courses by creating excellent drainage, filtration and stabilisation
solutions to help maintain optimum field conditions while reducing construction and
maintenance costs for our customers.

[More »][160]
✕
[Civic-landscaping-thumbnail]

### Civic & Landscaping

Geofabrics offers a range of engineered slope, embankment and retaining wall solutions used to
construct civic and landscaping projects.

[More »][161]
✕
[Building-thumbnail]

### Building

Geofabrics offers a range of innovative geosynthetic solutions across the building sector, including
stormwater, structural, architectural and landscaping products.

[More »][162]
✕
[Primary-industry-thumbnail]

### Primary Industries

The use of geosynthetics in agricultural applications is growing, with increasing regulations
governing the containment and disposal of pesticides, fungicides and insecticides; the conservation
and protection of water; and the effects of climate change in the form of extreme weather events
like drought, heat-waves, and insect infestations.

[More »][163]

## PROTECTING THE WORLD FOR FUTURE GENERATIONS

Through engineering, science, and innovation, Geofabrics are solving big environmental and
infrastructure challenges using geosynthetics.

With our partners and customers we are protecting, containing and securing our world for tomorrow.

[Roads-thumbnail]

### Road

Geofabrics geosynthetics are used in roads to ensure the best construction performance to both
minimise construction costs and prevent costly maintenance disruptions.

Geofabrics provide solutions that encompass all road types, from temporary access tracks to high
volume roads.

[More »][149]
✕
[Waste-containment-thumbnail]

### Waste Management

Geosynthetic engineering is the use of synthetic materials in waste and containment projects to
achieve more cost effective, safer and more environmentally sound outcomes.

The design techniques bring numerous benefits to waste and containment projects, because
geosynthetics can better protect the environment, through the control of hazardous leachates and
liquors.

[More »][150]
✕
[Mining-thumbnail]

### Mining & Resources

Geosynthetic engineering is the use of synthetic materials in civil engineering and mining projects
to achieve more cost effective, environmentally sound and safer construction outcomes.

The design techniques bring particular benefits to mine sites, because geosynthetics maximise the
use of site soils and avoid the need to import additional construction materials. 

[More »][151]
✕
[Slopes-walls-thumbnail]

### Slopes & Walls

Geofabrics offers a range of engineered slope, embankment and retaining wall solutions used to
construct infrastructure projects.

[More »][152]
✕
[Rail-thumbnail]

### Rail

The Geofabrics Rail Division has critical design expertise and a long project history in
the utilisation of geosynthetics for the construction and maintenance of rail formations.

We offer a range of solutions for new track construction as well as renewal or maintenance of
existing railway tracks which can deliver both construction savings and life-cycle optimisation.

[More »][153]
✕
[Water-thumbnail]

### Water

Geosynthetic engineering is the use of synthetic materials in water storage and treatment projects
to achieve more cost effective, environmentally sound and safer construction outcomes.

[More »][154]
✕
[Coastal-thumbnail]

### Coastal

Coastal erosion is a significant problem in Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific with rising sea
levels, extreme storms and climate change having a significant impact on shorelines.

Geofabrics coastal solutions are designed to reduce the effects of coastal and estuarine erosion
whilst maintaining safety and amenity for the community.

[More »][155]
✕
[Tunnel-thumbnail]

### Tunnels

Tunnel construction, maintenance and longevity depends on optimal drainage, waterproofing, sealing,
portals, erosion control and load support.

Geofabrics can provide engineering solutions and testing to reduce costs, while maintaining design
life.

[More »][156]
✕
[Defence-thumbnail]

### Defence

Geosynthetic engineering on defence projects is the use of synthetic materials to achieve more
cost-effective, environmentally sound and safer construction outcomes.

[More »][157]
✕

### Renewable Energy

We develop geosynthetic solutions for renewable energy infrastructure to reduce cost, environmental
impact and risk, and add value to each project.

[More »][158]
✕
[Port-aviation-thumbnail]

### Ports & Aviation

Geofabrics has a range of geosynthetic solutions for both landside and seaside components of port
infrastructure, including reinforcing hardstand areas, consolidation of soft soils and marine
breakwaters.

[More »][159]
✕
[Sport thumbnail]

### Sport & Recreation

Our aim is to provide product solutions that maximise playing hours on natural and synthetic sport
fields, racetracks and golf courses by creating excellent drainage, filtration and stabilisation
solutions to help maintain optimum field conditions while reducing construction and
maintenance costs for our customers.

[More »][160]
✕

### Civic & Landscaping

Geofabrics offers a range of engineered slope, embankment and retaining wall solutions used to
construct civic and landscaping projects.

[More »][161]

[Building-thumbnail]

### Building

Geofabrics offers a range of innovative geosynthetic solutions across the building sector, including
stormwater, structural, architectural and landscaping products.

[More »][162]
✕
[Primary-industry-thumbnail]

### Primary Industries

The use of geosynthetics in agricultural applications is growing, with increasing regulations
governing the containment and disposal of pesticides, fungicides and insecticides; the conservation
and protection of water; and the effects of climate change in the form of extreme weather events
like drought, heat-waves, and insect infestations.

[More »][163]

[client-rating]

“Hardstand Construction using DUX W155 Geotextile : The project involved 500LM of the access road
and 13500m2 of permanent hardstand to accommodate heavy plant, equipment and materials commencing in
April 2021. Apart from the first week of work we experienced rain nearly every week and this then
totalled by the end of winter and completion one of the wettest winters in 60 years.

We managed to get most of the unsuitable overburden stripped to stockpile. Commencing the cut to
fill of the underlaying variable water sensitive clays we started to experience wet weather. While
we managed this by keeping compaction of all fill up to speed as it was been placed we still had
issues with the quality of the material been placed achieving suitable compaction.

Once we had the main cut to fill bench completed we had to leave the site idle for period due to
intense wet weather but to also plan the next part of the works

International Geosynthetics Society

The home of geosynthetics

[ Become an IGS Member ][265]

Introducing IGS

We are a learned society dedicated to the advancement of geotextiles, geomembranes and their related
products and technologies.

We connect engineers, researchers, and industry professionals through knowledge, events, and global
collaboration.

[ Learn More ][266]
[ [NEW IGS Geosynthetics Handbook] ][267]
[ Order Now ][268]
[sustainability]

Sustainability

Geosynthetics make infrastructure more sustainable. They extend the service life of roads, reduce
the use of aggregates, conserve and protect water, minimize land disturbance and control soil
erosion.

[ Learn More ][269]

IGS Membership

Join the International Geosynthetics Society and connect with a global network of professionals. 

With membership options for individuals (including students), corporate organisations, and premium
partners, IGS offers access to resources, events, and opportunities to support the growth of
geosynthetics worldwide.

Upcoming Events

Stay up to date with the latest IGS events, including conferences, webinars, and professional
development courses taking place around the world.

[ Explore Events ][274]

We are everywhere!

IGS membership is supported through local Chapters, which connect members within a specific country
or region. Chapters bring the global IGS community closer to home by organising local events,
webinars, networking opportunities, and professional development activities tailored to their area.

Joining a Chapter helps members connect with local engineers, researchers, academics, and industry
professionals while still benefiting from the international reach of the IGS. It’s a great way to
stay informed, build professional relationships, and support the advancement of geosynthetics
worldwide.

## Wang Deqi

##### (China)

Mr. Wang Deqi is the inventor of anti-UV weed mat in China, the  Deputy Director of the Innovation
Committee of the China Agricultural Plastics Society under the supervision of the Ministry of
Agriculture, and a member of the International Association of Geomaterials. Previously, Mr. Wang
served as the Workstation Director of the National Industrial Fabric Quality Supervision and
Inspection Center. Mr. Wang led his team to successfully upgrade the “anti-aging” geotextile to the
professional “anti exposure” stage, especially the weed mat (100-300g woven geotextile), with an
exposed service life of up to 10-15 years, the world’s highest level.

Today, I am applying to join the IGS Council in order to participate in academic exchanges,
technology promotion, and other related work, together with promoting the development and progress
of international geotextiles in the field of environmental protection, and fulfill the mission of
IGS.

## Huabei Liu

##### (China)

Dr. Huabei Liu is an engineering professor at Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST)
with 25 years of experience in geosynthetic applications. Prior to joining HUST, he was granted
tenure as an associate professor at the City University of New York in Dec. 2013. His research
focuses on the long-term and dynamic responses of GRS structures, which has been materialized as
more than 80 refereed journal papers, and has promoted the applications of GRS structures in
earthquake-active areas and advanced the use of locally-available fill materials for GRS
applications.

Dr. Liu has been an active member of IGS since 2009. Currently he is an IGS Council Member, the
Secretary for the Chinese Chapter, an executive board member of China Technological Association of
Geosynthetics, and a member of ISSMGE TC 218 “Reinforced fill materials”. He also serves on the
editorial boards of the Canadian Geotechnical Journal, Computers and Geotechnics, Earthquake
Engineering and Structural Dynamics, and Transportation Infrastructure Geotechnology.

Dr. Liu is looking forward to better serving the community. He is particularly interested in
educating younger generations on geosynthetics, and promoting GRS applications in extreme
environments.

##### (China)

Mr. Wang Deqi is the inventor of anti-UV weed mat in China, the  Deputy Director of the Innovation
Committee of the China Agricultural Plastics Society under the supervision of the Ministry of
Agriculture, and a member of the International Association of Geomaterials. Previously, Mr. Wang
served as the Workstation Director of the National Industrial Fabric Quality Supervision and
Inspection Center. Mr. Wang led his team to successfully upgrade the “anti-aging” geotextile to the
professional “anti exposure” stage, especially the weed mat (100-300g woven geotextile), with an
exposed service life of up to 10-15 years, the world’s highest level.

Today, I am applying to join the IGS Council in order to participate in academic exchanges,
technology promotion, and other related work, together with promoting the development and progress
of international geotextiles in the field of environmental protection, and fulfill the mission of
IGS.

## Huabei Liu

##### (China)

Dr. Huabei Liu is an engineering professor at Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST)
with 25 years of experience in geosynthetic applications. Prior to joining HUST, he was granted
tenure as an associate professor at the City University of New York in Dec. 2013. His research
focuses on the long-term and dynamic responses of GRS structures, which has been materialized as
more than 80 refereed journal papers, and has promoted the applications of GRS structures in
earthquake-active areas and advanced the use of locally-available fill materials for GRS
applications.

Dr. Liu has been an active member of IGS since 2009. Currently he is an IGS Council Member, the
Secretary for the Chinese Chapter, an executive board member of China Technological Association of
Geosynthetics, and a member of ISSMGE TC 218 “Reinforced fill materials”. He also serves on the
editorial boards of the Canadian Geotechnical Journal, Computers and Geotechnics, Earthquake
Engineering and Structural Dynamics, and Transportation Infrastructure Geotechnology.

educating younger generations on geosynthetics, and promoting GRS applications in extreme
environments.

## WELCOME

The South African Chapter of the International Geosynthetics Society (IGS) established in 1994.


You will find on this site comprehensive information on Geosynthetics – what they are, their
functions, applications and technical information – together with current news on happenings in the
Geosynthetic sector in South Africa. We will provide information on upcoming conferences and events
locally and  worldwide plus offer reports emerging from these conferences and news from relevant
industry peers.

ABOUT

## ABOUT

GIGSA was founded in 1994 by a group of suppliers, installers, consultants, a regulator and an
academic at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of the Witwatersrand. The founding of GIGSA
coincided with the publication of the first edition of the Minimum Requirements Series by the then
Department of Water Affairs and Forestry. The intention of the Minimum Requirements was to regulate
waste management as a whole, but also waste disposal by landfill in South Africa, which made the use
of geomembranes mandatory. This reinforced the need for an organization like GIGSA, as geosynthetics
were largely unknown construction materials at that time.


GIGSA was, furthermore, founded as the South African Chapter of the International Society of
Geosynthetics (IGS). The IGS was established in 1984 with, in broad terms, the same objectives as
GIGSA.  The IGS became the first non-founding member of the Federation of Geo-Engineering Societies
(FedIGS) in 2011.  The founding members of the FedIGS are the International Society of Soil
Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering (ISSMGE), the International Society of Rock Mechanics (ISRM)
and the International Association for Engineering Geology and the Environment (IAEG).  The aim of
the FedIGS is to facilitate collaboration and provide means of structured and formal communication
between the organizations.

### OUR MISSION

To promote the understanding and appropriate use of geosynthetic technology throughout South Africa

## WELCOME

The South African Chapter of the International Geosynthetics Society (IGS) established in 1994.


You will find on this site comprehensive information on Geosynthetics – what they are, their
functions, applications and technical information – together with current news on happenings in the
Geosynthetic sector in South Africa. We will provide information on upcoming conferences and events
locally and  worldwide plus offer reports emerging from these conferences and news from relevant
industry peers.

ABOUT

## ABOUT

GIGSA was founded in 1994 by a group of suppliers, installers, consultants, a regulator and an
academic at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of the Witwatersrand. The founding of GIGSA
coincided with the publication of the first edition of the Minimum Requirements Series by the then
Department of Water Affairs and Forestry. The intention of the Minimum Requirements was to regulate
waste management as a whole, but also waste disposal by landfill in South Africa, which made the use
of geomembranes mandatory. This reinforced the need for an organization like GIGSA, as geosynthetics
were largely unknown construction materials at that time.


GIGSA was, furthermore, founded as the South African Chapter of the International Society of
Geosynthetics (IGS). The IGS was established in 1984 with, in broad terms, the same objectives as
GIGSA.  The IGS became the first non-founding member of the Federation of Geo-Engineering Societies
(FedIGS) in 2011.  The founding members of the FedIGS are the International Society of Soil
Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering (ISSMGE), the International Society of Rock Mechanics (ISRM)
and the International Association for Engineering Geology and the Environment (IAEG).  The aim of
the FedIGS is to facilitate collaboration and provide means of structured and formal communication
between the organizations.

### OUR MISSION

To promote the understanding and appropriate use of geosynthetic technology throughout South Africa

## Durable, Innovative, and Environmentally Friendly Products

We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality products that enhance durability, sustainability, and
operational efficiency. Cutting-edge solutions, like the Terralink® MSE wall system, help extend
landfill capacity while minimising environmental impact. With a focus on innovation and long-term
performance, we offer products that ensure the success of your project.

[The Great Wall of Sydney: Erskine Park’s Landfill MSE Wall]

## Award Winning Solutions

We are thrilled to announce that Global Synthetics Erskine Park Landfill MSE Wall has been honoured
with the ATA International 2024 Achievement Award of Excellence for our groundbreaking work on the
Erskine Park Landfill live expansion project, famously known as the “Great Wall of Sydney.”

This award is a testament to our innovative approach and unwavering commitment to excellence in the
face of complex engineering challenges.

## Our Products

Global Synthetics offers a comprehensive range of geosynthetic products, including geotextiles,
geogrids, gabions, geosynthetic clay liners, dewatering tubes, turf reinforcement mats, and drainage
solutions. Utilising cutting-edge technology and advanced materials, Global Synthetics is dedicated
to providing top-quality products and exceptional service.

### Discover our range of solutions

## Durable, Innovative, and Environmentally Friendly Products

We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality products that enhance durability, sustainability, and
operational efficiency. Cutting-edge solutions, like the Terralink® MSE wall system, help extend
landfill capacity while minimising environmental impact. With a focus on innovation and long-term
performance, we offer products that ensure the success of your project.

[Browse our range ][160]

[The Great Wall of Sydney: Erskine Park’s Landfill MSE Wall]

## Award Winning Solutions

We are thrilled to announce that Global Synthetics Erskine Park Landfill MSE Wall has been honoured
with the ATA International 2024 Achievement Award of Excellence for our groundbreaking work on the
Erskine Park Landfill live expansion project, famously known as the “Great Wall of Sydney.”

This award is a testament to our innovative approach and unwavering commitment to excellence in the
face of complex engineering challenges.

## Our Products

Global Synthetics offers a comprehensive range of geosynthetic products, including geotextiles,
geogrids, gabions, geosynthetic clay liners, dewatering tubes, turf reinforcement mats, and drainage
solutions. Utilising cutting-edge technology and advanced materials, Global Synthetics is dedicated
to providing top-quality products and exceptional service.

  Geosynthetic materials have become an indispensable core material in modern civil engineering,
  environmental protection, water conservancy and aquaculture construction. Featuring excellent
  anti-seepage, corrosion resistance, stabilization and anti-erosion properties, high-quality
  geomembranes and geotextiles effectively solve common engineering pain points such as water
  leakage, water quality deterioration, soil contamination and structural damage. To help global
  clients better understand the practical value and engineering adaptability of our geosynthetic
  products, we have sorted out five classic and verified engineering application cases covering
  transportation infrastructure, water conservancy projects, environmental governance, landscape
  engineering and modern aquaculture. All cases reflect the material’s advantages of high
  durability, cost-effectiveness, safety and eco-friendliness in actual projects. Highway & Railway
  Subgrade Stabilization Project Project Background Many road and railway construction sites are
  located on soft, humid, and low-bearing foundation soil. Without effective reinforcement and
  separation, the upper gravel layer will mix with the soft subgrade soil under long-term vehicle
  load and rainwater erosion, causing pavement rutting, uneven settlement, crack damage, and
  shortened service life. This problem is particularly prominent in coastal and plain soft soil
  areas. Geotextile Application Solution High-strength woven geotextiles and thickened non-woven
  geotextiles are laid between the subgrade soil and the aggregate cushion layer. Relying on the
  high tensile strength and stable structural performance of geotextiles, the material plays three
  core roles: physical separation to avoid the mixing of soil and gravel, structural reinforcement
  to disperse vehicle pressure and reduce foundation deformation, and auxiliary drainage to

Naue is a globally recognized partner for [geosynthetics][173] and engineering solutions. As a
German manufacturer with decades of experience, we offer proven [products][174] and systems for
construction, environmental protection, infrastructure development, coastal protection, and energy
projects. Our comprehensive portfolio includes **[geogrids][175], [geotextiles][176],
[geomembranes][177], drainage systems, [erosion control][178], and sealing solutions** – developed
to meet the highest technical and environmental standards.

# skaps industries

## committed to your success

**SKAPS Industries** is a leading manufacturer and supplier of various extrusion-based geosynthetic
products & technical textiles. We have a strong market presence in over 60 countries, offering our
clients a wide array of products. Whether it’s Geosynthetics, Fiberglass Fabrics, or Structural Core
Material, our wealth of manufacturing experience enables us to offer the best quality products. 

[ EXPLORE PRODUCTS ][44]
[Manufacturing worker reviews data on laptop]
[ ][45]

### [ Geocomposite ][46]

Drainage products made with Geonets and NW Geotextiles

[ ][47]

### [ Geotextile ][48]

Woven and Non-Woven Geotextiles designed with 100% Polypropylene resin

[ ][49]

### [ Geogrid ][50]

PP Geogrids designed for soil stabilization and reinforcement

[ ][51]

### [ Geonet ][52]

Three dimensional bi-planar Geonets laminated with NW Geotextile

### [ Nexatube - Dewatering & Containment Tube ][53]

High-tenacity woven polypropylene for Dewatering, Filtration and Containment

[ ][54]

### [ Geomembrane ][55]

Unreinforced HDPE and LLDPE Geomembranes

### [ Geosynthetic Clay Liner ][56]

Needle-punched Reinforced GCL

[ ][57]

### [ SKAPS Hydrotex ][58]

Highly engineered form fabric for diverse applications

[ ][59]

### [ Fiberglass ][60]

Innovative & cost-effective composite fabric solutions

[ ][61]

### [ Industrial & Agricultural ][62]

NW & Woven Geotextiles ideal for industrial & agricultural applications

#### Serving Over 60 Countries

## Skaps industries provides

#### 01.

[

### Geosynthetics

][63]

*Geosynthetics* are synthetic products used to stabilize terrain. They are generally polymeric
products used to solve civil engineering problems.

#### 02.

[

### Fiberglass Fabrics

][64]

Cheaper and more flexible than carbon fiber, it is stronger than many metals by weight,
non-magnetic, non-conductive, transparent to electromagnetic radiation.

#### 03.

### Structural Core Material

Composite core materials are customized to complete the function of engineered structures.

#### 04.

### civil applications

Skaps Geosynthetics are used as drains and filters in civil and environmental activities in addition
to replacement of conventional materials.

#### 05.

[

### environmental applications

][65]

Skaps Geosynthetics are used in a variety of situations including pipeline construction, water
filtration, prevention of soil erosion, and protection. 

#### 06.

[

### industrial applications

][66]

These applications include roads, airfields, railroads, embankments, retaining structures,
reservoirs, canals, dams, and more.

We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality products that enhance durability, sustainability, and
operational efficiency. Cutting-edge solutions, like the Terralink® MSE wall system, help extend

## Award Winning Solutions

We are thrilled to announce that Global Synthetics Erskine Park Landfill MSE Wall has been honoured
with the ATA International 2024 Achievement Award of Excellence for our groundbreaking work on the
Erskine Park Landfill live expansion project, famously known as the “Great Wall of Sydney.”

This award is a testament to our innovative approach and unwavering commitment to excellence in the
face of complex engineering challenges.

Global Synthetics offers a comprehensive range of geosynthetic products, including geotextiles,
geogrids, gabions, geosynthetic clay liners, dewatering tubes, turf reinforcement mats, and drainage
solutions. Utilising cutting-edge technology and advanced materials, Global Synthetics is dedicated

### Discover our range of solutions

## Durable, Innovative, and Environmentally Friendly Products

We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality products that enhance durability, sustainability, and
operational efficiency. Cutting-edge solutions, like the Terralink® MSE wall system, help extend
landfill capacity while minimising environmental impact. With a focus on innovation and long-term
performance, we offer products that ensure the success of your project.

[The Great Wall of Sydney: Erskine Park’s Landfill MSE Wall]

## Award Winning Solutions

We are thrilled to announce that Global Synthetics Erskine Park Landfill MSE Wall has been honoured
with the ATA International 2024 Achievement Award of Excellence for our groundbreaking work on the
Erskine Park Landfill live expansion project, famously known as the “Great Wall of Sydney.”

This award is a testament to our innovative approach and unwavering commitment to excellence in the
face of complex engineering challenges.

## Our Products

Global Synthetics offers a comprehensive range of geosynthetic products, including geotextiles,
geogrids, gabions, geosynthetic clay liners, dewatering tubes, turf reinforcement mats, and drainage
solutions. Utilising cutting-edge technology and advanced materials, Global Synthetics is dedicated
to providing top-quality products and exceptional service.

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

## Let’s build a better way forward

### We are a North American leader in the supply, installation and fabrication of high-quality
### geosynthetics and specialty civil engineering construction products that help manage the
### environment and prolong the life of critical infrastructure.

We offer a range of innovative, low-impact and cost-effective solutions designed to protect soil,
water, and air, and reduce carbon footprint. Our products are used in civil, environmental, and
geotechnical projects in a variety of sectors, including Civil Infrastructure, Water and Wastewater
Management, Mining, Oil and Gas, Hydroelectric, Agriculture and Sports & Recreation. We pride
ourselves on three principles of Trust. Quality. Value, putting client relationships, superior
products, and value at the forefront of what we do.

## Featured Tool: Titan Road Design Calculator

The Titan Road Design Calculator is a powerful online design tool built to simplify
geogrid-supported roadway design for engineers, contractors, and project owners. Using
industry-recognized methodologies—including Giroud-Han for unpaved roads and Modified AASHTO 1993
for paved and unpaved applications—the calculator delivers instant design calculations and
reinforcement recommendations based on your project-specific inputs. Generate detailed PDF design
summaries and optimize aggregate thickness with confidence. Whether you’re designing haul roads,
access roads, working platforms, or permanent pavements, the Calculator helps you make faster,
smarter, and more cost-effective design decisions.

[Try the Calculator][55]

For over two decades, Titan has grown from a small installation team into a trusted provider of
geosynthetic, environmental, and infrastructure solutions across North America. Built on a
foundation of problem-solving, technical expertise, and strong partnerships, we help customers
protect critical infrastructure, manage water and containment challenges, and stabilize land for
long-term performance. As we celebrate 20 years, we remain focused on delivering practical,
engineered solutions that perform in the field—today and into the future.

# The Leader in Total CCR Management, Construction & Environmental Compliance

## Join Our Team

We're always on the lookout for the best people who are dedicated to their work, from beginner to
expert, we have a variety of opportunities available.

[View Current Openings][32]

## Start a Project

We're here to help! If you are in need of our services, have a question, or want us to get started
with your next project, contact our team of experts.

[Contact Trans Ash][33]

## Become A Supplier

Follow the recommended steps and complete our online registration form to be considered as a Trans
Ash Supplier.

[Supplier Registration][34]

## Solutions Built With Integrity

[

### CCR Basin Closure

When closing a CCR basin, we work with all federal, state, and local water regulators to obtain the
necessary permits to protect the environment. When the CCR basin is closed, we utilize EPA-approved
covers and fills to protect and maintain the integrity of the closed basin.

** Service Details
][35]
[

### CCR Landfill Closure

We help utility companies evaluate options to close and improve existing landfills in order to
protect public safety and comply with regulations. Although we have closed several landfills with
traditional methods, we also hire experienced liner companies and subcontractors to provide critical
components.

** Service Details
][36]
[

### CCR Landfill Construction

We are proud to tackle the largest and most challenging CCR landfill construction projects. We find
the ideal solution by combining effective landfill construction with disposal options for
non-marketable CCRs, which includes a well-planned landfill management program.

** Service Details
][37]
[

### CCR Landfill Management

We have operated numerous landfills for our customers over a vast geographical area. We offer a
variety of services to ensure that all aspects of the landfill development, construction, and
management process are covered.

** Service Details
][38]
[

### Civil Construction

With our fleet of advanced equipment, trained personnel, and a robust management team, we can
efficiently, safely, and accurately handle any Civil Construction project for Utilities and Power
Generation Facilities.

** Service Details
][39]
[

### Dredging

Dredging and sediment removal is used for a number of purposes, including waterway maintenance,
creating freshwater sources, and helping with wastewater treatment. Unlike other dredging companies,
we have the experience suited for any site design and construction.

** Service Details
][40]
[

### Plant Support

With highly trained personnel, a dynamic management team, and the right equipment needed for the
job, we provide a full range of operations and plant support services to complement our construction
business.

** Service Details
][41]
[

### Grounds Maintenance

With our years of experience with power plant construction, electric utility systems, and power
generation plants, we’ve handled everything for our clients from grass cutting to landscape storm
damage repair.

** Service Details
][42]

Our Quality Division is built on the philosophy that delivering high standards and maintaining a "no
excuses" mindset are values reflected by all team members.

**

### Diversity & Inclusion

Our mission is to reflect the diverse communities we represent and support a more diverse
environment.

**

### Welcome to tynod geosynthetics

* [Our History]
  
  ## Our History
  
  Our HDPE geomembrane has been CE certified. Our YINGFAN company is located in Zhujiajiao industry
  park of Shanghai city in China. We have branch companies in Chengdu city and Xian city, two of
  mega cities in our country.
* [Our Factory]
  
  ## Our Factory
  
  We established our installation team at the same time with company establishment and were
  qualified by our government agency. Our company's Qualification Category and Level: B-level
  Qualification of Specialized Contractor of Waterproof (corrosion-proof and insulation)
  Engineering.
* [Our Service]
  
  ## Our Service
  
  We are always dedicated in providing top quality products and services for our global customers
  via our first-rate technics, rich industry manufacturing experiences, full-range testing equipment
  and excellent professional and purpose-fit services.

## [About Us][37]

Shanghai Yingfan Engineering Materials Co., Ltd., initiated in 2006, is one of leading companies
specialized in producing geosynthetics, providing installation service and relevant equipment in
China. Certified by ISO9001, ISO14001 and OHSAS18001, our company produce a series of
environment-friendly geosynthetics including geomembrane, geotextile, geosynthetic clay liner (GCL),
composite geomembrane/geotextile, drainage geocomposite, geonet, geogrid, geofiltration fabric, etc.
based on strict international and domestic standards.
